verdict.rationale: Cooley offers a law-firm service and the Cooley GO document generators, so asking about data export and portability is a fair question. The evidence never mentions exporting user data, open file formats, or account portability. The packs only describe which legal documents can be generated, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI returned 404s.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
